svg.title: IS-01: a person crosses the aisle ahead at walking pace, looping
svg.desc: Looping top view of IS-01: in a warehouse aisle between two rack rows the robot drives at 0.2 m/s with its protective field FS-1b drawn ahead of it as four bands, the robot's travel during the reaction time, the coast, the person's walk and the tolerance; a person walks into the field at 1.6 m/s; the field outline turns red at the demand, the contactors open at 0.17 s, the robot coasts to a standstill at 0.57 s; the events light up below, a cursor runs along a time strip, and a plot shows the distance from the person to the robot's front falling to 0.72 m in the planning case.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The person is briefed staff, closest 0 m if the robot does not stop (WP-C-06 §2). A viewer that shows the SVG as a still shows t = -0.4 s.
